profile.bio:
Raven DeNoir writes dangerous love stories for readers who crave obsession, betrayal, and power that bites. She builds heat and havoc across BWWM dark mafia romance, contemporary romance, shifter paranormal romance, and erotic romance.

Her debut saga, Vows & Vengeance, is a BWWM powerhouse set in the brutal underworlds of Boston, Baltimore, and beyond. Irish kings, Black heroines who never bow, vows sealed in blood, and HEAs carved from chaos. Start with Dark Vows, where trust is earned in blood and love refuses to ask permission.

Her contemporary line, The Ache, delivers emotionally raw, high-heat BWWM romance in both novels and sharp, addictive novellas. Each standalone centers a strong Black woman who chooses herself first, matched with a man who meets her where she stands. No fade to black, only grown-folks love that heals what hurt, whether in bakery kitchens, storm-lashed cabins, small-town dive bars, or sleek penthouses.

So, About Last Night explores the morning after a choice that changed everything. Short, sultry BWWM stories that begin with desire and tell the truth about consequence. Some nights save a marriage, some reopen old wounds, some end in silence or blood, yet every one is unforgettable.

The Emberrun is a dark, shifter-paranormal BWWM romance set in a cursed Vermont mountain town where the forest watches and the wolves keep score. Three Hollowborn alphas bound by fire, one Solenya who was never meant to survive, fated mates, primal rituals, found family, and a heroine who refuses to bow, even to destiny.

When she is not breaking hearts on the page, Raven is playlist building, moodboarding villains, or whispering plot twists into the dark. She is open to media, licensing, and publishing inquiries. To connect, visit her official platforms.
